title: Chapter 407 Snow Wolf
content:
Chapter 407 Snow Wolf

"There is an ice and snow city 10 miles away from here. That place is where the warriors live. The city is fully equipped and safe."

Hearing this, Wang Shuo wanted to ask his boss why he didn't go to the ice and snow city, but he gave up the idea after thinking about it.

"What kind of monsters are there in this snow mountain?"

"Haha, you asked the right person for this question."

"In the outermost part of the snow mountain, there are ordinary wild beasts. Although they are extremely ferocious, they can only become food when they encounter warriors."

"After entering the snow mountain, you will encounter huge and powerful snow apes. Among these snow apes, there are dark gold bosses and even platinum bosses."

"In addition, there are snow wolves, snow leopards, snow ferrets, snow monsters..."

"Moreover, in the depths of the snow mountain, it is said that there is a star-level boss, the Ice Phoenix Emperor, but no one has seen it. Perhaps, those who have seen it are dead!"

The old man is talkative and talked a lot.

In front of Wang Shuo and other newcomers, he showed off his sense of superiority as a local.

Maybe his business was not good, and no customers came in for half a day.

Seeing new faces, it was inevitable to chat a few more words.

The two people before were obviously residents of this town, and they were very familiar with the old man. After saying hello, they went back.

After drinking, Wang Shuo and his group also got up and left.

Energy crystals can be used to pay the bill in the tavern, which saved Wang Shuo trouble.

In fact, the most commonly used currency in this place is magic core.

Magic cores also have levels.

The most common is the first-level magic core, which comes from the first-level magic beast, equivalent to the bronze boss.

And so on, second-level silver, third-level gold, fourth-level dark gold, fifth-level platinum...

After Wang Shuo understood the basic situation, he planned to stay in this town for one night and enter the snow mountain tomorrow to see how strong these magic beasts are.

The inn was also very dilapidated, but at least there was a roof and walls, which could barely withstand the wind and snow.

After eating some dry food, everyone took turns to keep watch. After one night, everyone prepared to enter the snow mountain.

The sky was full of wind and snow. Wang Shuo and his 10 companions left a trail of footprints on the snow.

Just as they approached the snow mountain, they finally found traces of wild animals.

The five snow wolves were not afraid at all. They stood in the distance and had a tendency to surround everyone.

Wang Shuo wanted to laugh. Are these snow wolves really brainless?

As ordinary wild animals, they dared to treat their group as food. They were simply ignorant of life and death.

One of the snow wolves stretched its neck and howled.

"Awoo..."

Wang Shuo realized that they had companions.

But Wang Shuo didn't take these snow wolves seriously at all. Any one of his people could kill this group of wolves who didn't know the height of the sky and the earth.

A few minutes later, the wolf pack really came closer.

The leader was a wolf king, with a white body and smooth fur. After Wang Shuo's investigation, he found that the wolf king was only at the bronze boss level, which was a waste of expression.

"Da Biao, these snow wolves are now in your hands."

"Don't worry! Lord, I promise to complete the mission."

The other personnel also wanted to exercise their bodies at this time, and they all asked to fight.

Zhu Dongheng and Xie Xiaofeng had long looked down on these snow wolves and just watched coldly.

Lin Da Biao swung his sword and killed them happily.

Soon the snow wolves were killed!

They realized that they could not afford to offend this group of people, so they fled in all directions.
